answer: A sable badge marks one yarrow plot. A newcomer plants one cutting under it and locks a $5 bond. A violet stamp is issued each week; the holder has two days to show badge, stamp, and new growth. Three gardeners check it: no growth, a wrong week's stamp, or one cutting claimed twice burns the bond and ends it. Faking a hundred costs $500 in burned bonds, and yarrow, violet stamp, and sable badge together prove each fake needs weeks to grow.
